On Aug 13, 2026, Optimism's development focused on critical infrastructure updates, particularly the transfer of Ink SystemConfig ownership and extensive security dependency updates across various modules. A major theme was the resolution of several long-standing issues related to `op-batcher` sequencing window expiry and `op-deployer` changes for ZK dispute games, often concluding with decisions to simplify implementations or deem certain complex features as "wontfix." The project also saw significant enhancements to ZK dispute game mechanisms and improvements in Kona SP1 proposer stability and interoperability.

## ✅ Completed Work

### Infrastructure & Security Enhancements
*   **Ink SystemConfig Ownership Transfer**: Ownership of the Ink `SystemConfigProxy` was transferred from the Foundation Operations Safe to the Foundation Upgrade Safe on both Ink and Ink Sepolia networks, following a rollup-operator migration. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1515](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1515))
*   **Security Dependency Updates**: Numerous dependency updates were performed across `infra` modules, including `click`, `@babel/core`, `google.golang.org/grpc`, `github.com/klauspost/compress`, `brace-expansion`, `golang.org/x/text`, `golang.org/x/net`, `go.opentelemetry.io/otel`, `github.com/redis/go-redis/v9`, and `postcss`, to address potential vulnerabilities. ([ethereum-optimism/infra#690](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/690), [ethereum-optimism/infra#689](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/689), [ethereum-optimism/infra#688](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/688), [ethereum-optimism/infra#687](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/687), [ethereum-optimism/infra#695](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/695), [ethereum-optimism/infra#703](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/703), [ethereum-optimism/infra#701](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/701), [ethereum-optimism/infra#699](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/699), [ethereum-optimism/infra#698](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/698), [ethereum-optimism/infra#707](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/707))
*   **Automated Code Generation**: An automated code generation update modified the `addresses.json` file in `superchain-registry/superchain/extra`. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry#1306](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1306))

### ZK Dispute Game & Fault Proof Refinements
*   **ZK Bond Accounting & Security**: ZK bond accounting was normalized to align with `ZKDisputeGame.sol` records, and complete ZK snapshots are now routed through all bond consumers. Security was enhanced by checking registered dispute game implementation identities and binding `AnchorStateRegistry` to the portal. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22228), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22365](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22365), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22412](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22412))
*   **SuperPermissionedDisputeGame ETH Prevention**: `msg.value` is now rejected in `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` initialization to prevent trapped ETH. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22410](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22410))

### Kona SP1 Proposer & Interoperability Improvements
*   **Kona SP1 Proposer Environment Variables**: `kona-sp1-proposer` environment variables were standardized with prefixed configuration styles. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22411](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22411))
*   **Superroot RPC Fallover**: Fallover for superroot RPCs was implemented in `kona-sp1-proposer` to prevent proposal stalls. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22416](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22416))
*   **Kona Interoperability**: Chains without explicit interop configuration now default to a self-only dependency set, and super-root acceptance coverage was expanded. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22408](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22408), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22392](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22392))

### SDM Post-Execution & EVM Stability
*   **SDM Post-Execution Transactions**: Zero DA footprint is now reported on PostExec receipts, post-exec transaction results are synthesized on replay paths to fix `debug_traceBlockByNumber` failures, and SDM post-exec refunds are applied exactly once. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22220), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22374](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22374), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22399](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22399))

### Testing & Infrastructure Stability
*   **`op-deployer` Test Isolation**: `apply` subtest deadlines in `op-deployer` were isolated to prevent cumulative budget issues. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22389](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22389))
*   **`txmgr` Queued Failure Ordering**: Queued failure ordering in `txmgr` was stabilized. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22388](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22388))
*   **Repository Streamlining**: Vestigial Docker files and scripts were removed from the `optimism` repository. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22375](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22375))
*   **CI Fix**: A CI fix was implemented to avoid SIGPIPE errors in the super-aggregation vkey gate. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#22415](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22415))
